_comment: Temporary headroom above the ceilings in scripts/fleet-drift.ts, enforced by
scripts/check-instruction-ceilings.ts in CI. Every value here is debt: the target
is 0. A value may be lowered freely; raising one is a deliberate, reviewable act
that needs a reason in the PR body. Once a file is back under its ceiling the
gate REQUIRES its allowance be set to 0, so the headroom cannot be re-taken.
CLAUDE.md carried 1733 B of debt when this gate was introduced; it had been
pruned under the ceiling three times and re-inflated each time.
